title: Mandi Selling Guide for Smallholder Farmers
title_hi: छोटे किसानों के लिए मंडी बिक्री गाइड
content:
Selling your harvest at the right time and place can mean 20-40% more income. Here's what every smallholder farmer should know:

1. Know the MSP: Minimum Support Price is the government's guaranteed minimum price. If mandi prices are below MSP, sell to FCI (Food Corporation of India) instead.

2. Grade your produce: Clean, sorted, graded produce fetches 10-15% higher prices. Remove damaged grains, foreign matter, and moisture before taking to mandi.

3. Check multiple mandis: Prices can vary ₹200-500/quintal between mandis just 50km apart. Use AgriMesh /prices to compare.

4. Timing matters: Prices are typically lowest at harvest peak (Oct-Nov for Kharif, Mar-Apr for Rabi). If you can store safely, waiting 4-6 weeks after harvest peak can improve prices 15-25%.

5. Avoid distress sales: Never sell immediately after harvest to pay off loans — the commission agent knows you're desperate. Plan your finances so you have 4-6 weeks of buffer.

6. FCI procurement: For rice and wheat, FCI buys at MSP. Carry your Aadhaar, bank passbook, and land records. Register on the FCI portal before harvest season.
content_hi:
सही समय और जगह पर फसल बेचने से 20-40% अधिक आमदनी हो सकती है।

1. MSP जानें: न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य सरकार की गारंटीड कीमत है।
2. फसल की ग्रेडिंग करें: साफ, छंटा हुआ अनाज 10-15% अधिक भाव पर बिकता है।
3. कई मंडियों के भाव देखें।
4. समय का ध्यान रखें: कटाई के चरम पर भाव सबसे कम होते हैं।
5. मजबूरी में न बेचें।
6. FCI खरीद: धान और गेहूं के लिए FCI MSP पर खरीदता है।
summary: Selling at the right mandi and time can increase income 20-40%. Grade produce, check multiple mandis, avoid harvest-peak distress sales.
summary_hi: सही मंडी और समय पर बेचने से 20-40% अधिक आय हो सकती है। फसल की ग्रेडिंग करें, कई मंडियों के भाव देखें।
actions: Grade your produce before taking to mandi — remove damaged grains, stones, and foreign matter.
Check prices at 2-3 nearby mandis using /prices command before deciding where to sell.
If current mandi price is below MSP, locate the nearest FCI procurement center and sell there instead.
Store 30-40% of your harvest if prices are below seasonal average — wait 4-6 weeks for price recovery.
Avoid selling the entire harvest at once — staggered selling reduces risk.
warnings: Do NOT sell to the first commission agent (आढ़तिया) who approaches you at the farm gate — their price is usually 15-25% below mandi rate.
Never take an advance (साई) from a trader against future harvest — this locks you into below-market prices.
